infobox.usage: Unlocks the marked room on the first floor of the Chekannaya 13 apartment building on Streets of Tarkov.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Mysterious room marked key (Chek. 13) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A mysterious key from an unknown door located at house 13 Chekannaya Street. There is a strange symbol scratched on the key.

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text:
- This is a required location for the quest Broadcast - Part 5
- Used in the story chapter Blue Fire when you don't have a Car dealership closed section key
- Used in the story chapter The Ticket

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Drawers
- In Jackets
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: Marked room on the first floor of the Chekannaya 13 apartment building at Streets of Tarkov.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text: - Loose loot (multiple very rare Valuables, Weapons, Containers, Currency, Keycards)
